pr_title: planner, CTE: Fix default inline CTE which contains agg or window function and refactor inline CTE strategy | tidb-test=pr/2239
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #47711
close #47603

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

1. Forbidden CTE inline when it contains or indirectly contains agg or window and is referenced by recursive part of CTE.
2. The fake recursive CTE can be identified and judged as non-recursive CTE. (mark as recursive but query has no recursive part)
3. Refactor the CTE inline strategy 

**Refactor**
Unified inline strategy logic in CTE used. 
1. preprocessor and buildCTE() : collect CTE info such as ```consumerCount, forceInlineByHintOrVar,  containAggOrWindow ```
2. tryBuildCTE() :  Combine the declaration of CTE and the use of CTE to jointly determine **whether a CTE can be inlined**.

issue_context.title: CTE query execute failed:Recursive Common Table Expression '' can contain neither aggregation nor window functions in recursive query block
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

The results of cte query execution are different in v6.1.6 and v6.5.2 .

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

create table a (id int);
create table b (id int);
create table temp (lvl int);
with a as (select 8 as id from dual),
maxa as (select max(id) as max_id from a),
b as (
with recursive temp as (
select 1 as lvl from dual
union all
select lvl+1 from temp, maxa where lvl < max_id
)
select * from temp
)
select * from b;

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

**v6.1.6**
mysql> with a as (select 8 as id from dual),
    -> maxa as (select max(id) as max_id from a),
    -> b as (
    -> with recursive temp as (
    -> select 1 as lvl from dual
    -> union all
    -> select lvl+1 from temp, maxa where lvl < max_id
    -> )
    -> select * from temp
    -> )
    -> select * from b;
+------+
| lvl  |
+------+
|    1 |
|    2 |
|    3 |
|    4 |
|    5 |
|    6 |
|    7 |
|    8 |
+------+
8 rows in set (0.01 sec)

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

**v6.5.2**
mysql> with a as (select 8 as id from dual),
    -> maxa as (select max(id) as max_id from a),
    -> b as (
    -> with recursive temp as (
    -> select 1 as lvl from dual
    -> union all
    -> select lvl+1 from temp, maxa where lvl < max_id
    -> )
    -> select * from temp
    -> )
    -> select * from b;
**ERROR 3575 (HY000): Recursive Common Table Expression '' can contain neither aggregation nor window functions in recursive query block**


### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

v6.5.2
comments: Bisect shows this issue is caused by #37800 :thinking: .

Regression Analysis
The issue didn't show up in v6.3.0 but started to show up in v6.4.0.

Regression Analysis
PR caused this regression: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/37800

review_comments: I think this check can also be moved to `tryBuildCTE`. Then `forceInlineByHintOrVar` can become `forceInlineByHint`, which is slightly simpler in my opinion.
Feel free to update it or keep it unchanged. I'm also OK with the current one.
```forceByVar``` can be moved to tryBuildCTE. But I want to separate CTE info and CTE inline judge logic. So I put the CTE info in buildCTE function and put the CTE inline judge logic in tryBuildCTE.

I think we can remove this field now.
Because it's no longer a property of a cte, it's checked every time we use the cte.
This property should be record in cte because the tryToBuildSequence use it later ~
